text:
Mira (marketing): heads-up — planning the public announce for Optimize v2 on Thu 09:00 PT. need the merged changelog url, docs quickstart, and a firm prod rollout cadence from eng so we can align blog, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing.
Ben (engineering): we can do a progressive rollout. suggested timeline: canary 05:00 PT, 10% at 06:00, 40% at 07:30, 80% at 08:45, pause for manual go at 08:55, full by 09:30 if metrics are healthy. rollback on sustained >4% 5xx for 4m.
Mira (marketing): marketing preference: blog live at 09:00 only if we hit the 80% gate by 08:45 and manual go at 08:55. we'll gate paid channels until 09:20 and sequence emails in small cohorts starting 09:10. organic social ok at 09:00.
Pri (docs): docs PR is in flight: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/711 — changelog section has the key bullets but I still need the final "user impact" line and a sample prefix-cache config. can we finalize those now?
Ben (engineering): user impact line: "Optimized for long contexts: faster multi-turn responses and lower per-token cost for many chat workloads." sample config snippet (draft):
```
optimize:
  prefix_cache: true
  dynamic_batching: true
  max_cache_entries: 10000
```
Kai (devex): webinar booked for 10:00 PT (demo + live Q&A). landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/events/optimize-v2-preview — need 3 short hero bullets and a one-sentence demo blurb for the landing page and email header. also: want a short troubleshooting FAQ for ops to use in the webinar Q&A.
Ben (engineering): hero bullets (concise):
- handles long conversations ~2x faster than v1
- lowers per-token spend by up to ~20% via smarter batching and cache reuse
- keeps 95th percentile tail latency under ~120ms on 32k context tests
demo blurb: "Watch Optimize v2 cut latency and cost for long-context apps."
Mira (marketing): good. please also provide a short safe-guard sentence we can use in social: "Results vary by workload and traffic; consult the docs for benchmarks."
Ben (engineering): caveat added: "Actual improvements depend on model, workload shape, and traffic — see docs for detailed benchmarks."
DeployBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-07-01T05:00:00Z, prod rollout start @ 2026-07-01T09:00:00Z. automated rollback threshold: sustained 5xx >4% for 4m.
Oncall: I'll monitor perf/err dashboards during the rollout and post status at each gate. escalate to infra if we hit rollback thresholds.
Pri (docs): merged changelog & quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 and https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2 — added migration notes, sample config, and a short benchmarks appendix. set up redirects for legacy guide.
Mira (marketing): perfect — marketing will circulate embargoed blog + social + email drafts to the approvals list by EOD. quick final day-of asks: eng please paste the merge link and gate status updates in this thread during rollout; docs confirm redirects live and quickstart runs locally; devex update landing page CTA to hit at 09:30; marketing will publish blog at 09:00 but hold mass sends until 09:20 and stagger emails starting 09:10.
Ben (engineering): noted. one ask: try to avoid a single large spike at 09:00 — sequence the top-of-funnel mail cohorts to avoid sudden traffic bursts while warm pools scale.
Mira (marketing): acknowledged — we'll phase email cohorts and hold paid promos until 09:20. inbound lead routing: we'll send signups to the webinar list immediately and route product interested leads to SalesOps; will confirm the exact webhook.
Pri (docs): added a short FAQ for the webinar: common gotchas, where to find migration steps, and how to report regressions. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2#faq.
Kai (devex): Ill add the FAQ link to the landing page and prep the demo kit for the webinar. will share the invite list + rehearsal time by EOD.
Oncall: posting a reminder — i'll ping here at each gate (05:00, 06:00, 07:30, 08:45, 08:55) with metrics snapshot.
Mira (marketing): thanks all — i'll compile a short runbook and post it here tomorrow morning. any last blockers?
Ben (engineering): none from infra. we'll post gate statuses and the merge confirmation in this thread during rollout.
Mira (marketing): great — appreciate the speed. :rocket:
